setup: Back on the pad at your shoulder blades
Belt or pad across your hip crease
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
execution: Tuck your chin and ribs down
Drive your hips up through your heels
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top
faults: Don't arch your lower back at the top

notes: Set the pad or belt so it sits across the hips, not the stomach, before loading.
Lockout is a strong glute squeeze with the ribs down, not an arched lower back.
Machines differ. Plate-loaded versions log the plates added; stack versions log the pin reading. Neither is the true resistance, and numbers aren't comparable with a barbell hip thrust.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Upper back on the pad, hips lowered with knees bent and feet flat. Chin tucked.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Hips driven up until the body is level from knees to shoulders, shins about vertical, ribs down, glutes squeezed.

ikHints: Upper back stays on the pad
Feet fixed on the footplate or floor
Hip belt or pad moves with the hips
emphasise: Hips rise to a level line, ribs down
doNotShow: Arched lower back at the top
Head pushed back into the pad
